section_path_text: MMI Daily Iron Ore Index Report August 11 2026
summary:
Main
Today, the iron ore market showed a relatively strong performance on the futures market. The DCE main contract I2609 closed at 721.5 yuan/ton,up 1.26% from the previous trading session. Spot prices at Qingdao Port rose by an average of about 3-6 yuan/ton from the previous trading day.
